title: Si può sapere un poco
subtitle: Don Alfonso, Guglielmo and Ferrando: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 12, recitative after No. 16
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (quà, Or bene as two words, Padrone, and the comma in silenzio, e ubbidienza).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 139–140, the recitative between No. 16 and No. 17 (27 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers (the two piano readings were identical), every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (one error found and corrected: in bar 3, Don Alfonso's “ri-so?” on two C's ends his question, and Guglielmo comes in on the next beat with “Eh”). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 3, 9, 17 and 19), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. The last bar is printed with two quarters before the double bar and “attacca Nr. 17”, and is set as 2/4. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100, estimated (no separate timing of this recitative was found; about 1 minute).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
